posts.title: Medical AI Validation: Beyond AUC
posts.description: Why AUC isn't enough for clinical AI: the C-statistic, NRI, IDI, calibration curves, Brier scores, and reclassification tables — the metrics that actually matter for getting your model into the hospital.

posts.title: Diffusion Models Meet Medical Reconstruction
posts.description: How denoising diffusion probabilistic models solve the PET reconstruction problem — from DDPM fundamentals to measurement-conditioned generation and why diffusion might beat both OSEM and GANs.

posts.title: GANs in the Hospital: Conditional Adversarial Networks for SPECT
posts.description: How conditional GANs solve the attenuation correction problem in SPECT imaging — from the clinical motivation to U-Net generators, PatchGAN discriminators, and why adversarial loss beats L1 alone.

posts.title: Reconstructing Reality: OSEM and the Math of PET Imaging
posts.description: From raw detector data to 3D images: the inverse problem of PET reconstruction, MLEM derivation, OSEM acceleration, and why every clinical PET scan you've seen was made with this algorithm.

posts.title: The DL Engineer's Field Guide to 3D Medical Imaging
posts.description: A crash course in 3D medical imaging for ML engineers: PET/SPECT physics, DICOM vs NIfTI, coordinate systems, and Python code to work with real clinical data.

posts.title: Hello World — Launching xyang.me
posts.description: Introducing my portfolio site built with React, Vite, and Tailwind v4. A technical overview of the architecture and content pipeline.

posts.title: microgpt-cpp: When You Rewrite Karpathy's 200 Lines of Python in C++ Because Why Not
posts.description: A faithful C++20 incarnation of Andrej Karpathy's microgpt — the most atomic way to train and run a GPT. No PyTorch. No dependencies. Just vibes and shared pointers.

projects.title: microgpt-cpp
projects.description: A faithful C++20 incarnation of Karpathy's microgpt — complete autograd, GPT training, and inference in a single header file. Zero dependencies.

projects.title: MiniLM
projects.description: A minimal JAX incarnation of full life cycle modern language model from scratch. Multi-device sharded pretraining of a Mixture-of-Experts foundation model with data and tensor parallelism on TPU Research Cloud.

projects.title: RelationalLearning
projects.description: Scaling up GNNs with GraphStore and FeatureStore via Remote Backends. Trained a GraphSAGE model on a 100 million nodes and 1.6 billion edges graph.

projects.title: Deep Learning for 3D Medical Imaging
projects.description: A pedagogical tutorial series: from DICOM/NIfTI handling and OSEM reconstruction to conditional GANs and diffusion models for PET/SPECT. Built for ML engineers with no medical physics background.
